dedupe_keys.name: techno economic data for hydrogen storage based microgrids

description: The Politecnico di Torino authors publish a workbook of technical and economic parameters for renewable-energy systems that use hydrogen storage. It covers electrolysers, fuel cells, batteries, hydrogen compressors and storage tanks. The deposit also contains learning curves and investment-cost functions derived from the underlying observations, with production scale and equipment size used to explain costs. Zenodo provides the Excel workbook as version 1.0.0, published on 19 July 2024. Access is free, under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; the non-commercial and no-derivatives conditions matter when distributing adapted material. The repository description does not define a geographic sample, observation period or refresh schedule, so this is a technology-parameter collection, not a national inventory. The workbook was not downloaded and its units were not checked. It can inform hydrogen-microgrid sizing and storage comparisons, and offers potential parameters for model-pypsa after the modeller checks units and modelling assumptions.
